messages:
marta: noticing a large spike in preemptible evictions in us-west1 over the last 5m — ~30% of inference pods restarted. 95th latency jumped from 320ms -> 1.2s. Request queueing on runtime.
ops-bot: [ALERT] cluster.us-west1: node.preemptions >= 25% in 5m. affected-pools: gpu-spot, gpu-mixed. autoscale events triggered.
kai: thanks — are these all GPU preemptions or network-related NTP/disk issues too?
marta: logs show `EvictionReason: PREEMPTION` and `GPU detach` errors. no obvious network flaps.
devon: cost note: we've been routing 65% traffic to spot pool to save ~$0.35/token. we can reroute but it'll add to monthly on-demand spend.
sasha: mitigation idea: temporary traffic shift to dedicated-oncall pool + raise min replicas on on-demand node groups. also enable fallback to smaller quantized model for latency-sensitive endpoints.
nate: doing a quick check on routing. running: `redwoodctl route update --region us-west1 --target dedicated-pool --weight 75`
kai: also lower batch wait to reduce tail latency: `service-config set inference.batch_wait_ms=5` for critical routes.
marta: can we enable autoscale override to prevent scale-down flapping? current policy is too aggressive.
nate: applied override: `autoscale set --pool gpu-spot --min 6 --override emergency-2026-03-18` — should reduce churn while we shift traffic.
devon: FYI if we shift 75% off spot to dedicated we estimate +$12k/day. tag that for finance post-incident.
sasha: started a canary to the quantized t_medium variant with 10% traffic and reduced batch windows.
marta: can everybody watch the 95th latency on the console? link: https://console.redwood/observability/us-west1/latency -> we're at 380ms after initial changes but still noisy.
ops-bot: [INFO] route update succeeded: dedicated-pool weight=75 by nate.
kai: we should also enable node-protection for dedicated instances to avoid accidental evictions during AZ maintenance: `gcloud compute instances update --no-preemptible` (or equivalent).
nate: adding a temporary AZ bias away from us-west1-b which seems to have highest eviction rate. `placement set-bias --region us-west1 --avoid-zone us-west1-b`
devon: will marketing care about degraded chat responsiveness? flagging product for potential user impact. @sasha can you give a heads-up?
sasha: pinged product and support channels. short status note in #statusboard sent.
marta: observed a queue backlog in the reranker workers too. added emergency cache warm: `cache invalidation disabled; warm prefixes=true`
kai: nice. also enable local kv-cache pin for hot prompts to cut token recompute.
ops-bot: [ALERT RESOLVE] cluster.us-west1 preemption rate returning to baseline (<5%) — monitoring for 15m.
marta: latency back to ~210ms 95th. will keep traffic at 70% dedicated for next 2 hrs to stabilize.
devon: logging the temporary cost delta and approval path.
sasha: we'll run a short RCA tomorrow. immediate actions: (1) reduce spot weight to 30% by region fallback policy, (2) add extra retry with exponential backoff on client SDK for interim, (3) update runbook to include AZ bias and autoscale emergency overrides.
kai: reminder: long-term we should add predictive preemption signals into scheduler to proactively migrate critical sessions off spot if eviction probability > 0.25.
marta: thanks team. nice fast triage. postmortem + cost writeup to follow. :thumbsup:
